title: The dashboard position value can be wrong: when the live quote fails the 'current price' falls back to the exit engine's high-water mark, which is a probe quote in different units, the no-exit-state fallback quotes the ETH cost as if it were a token amount, and after partial sells the full bought amount is quoted

evidence.note: quote amount = exitState.originalTokenAmount, or ethers.parseEther(trade.buy_cost) (an ETH amount in wei) used as a raw token amount when there is no exit_state row
quote failure: currentPrice = exitState.highWaterMark, priceStale = true
currentPrice / 1e18 sent as the position value
the code comment itself says originalTokenAmount overstates the holding after partial sells
Current shows the value with a "(stale)" tag; P&L next to it has no stale tag

sibling_sites_checked: Every number the positions helper sends (positions.ts:151-170): entryPrice and buyCost are the stored ETH cost (decimal string, correct unit), currentPrice and unrealizedPnl as above, pnl = realized_pnl and sellRevenue are the mixed-unit SQL results of AUD-DB-002 (sub_claim 4, DB slice, linked not repeated), exitState.highWaterMark is the raw engine value. The meaning of the engine's high-water mark (a fixed probe quote, not a price) is AUD-EXIT-003. The rendering of these fields is audited in the DASH slice.
severity_rationale: S3 misleading operator display: an operator deciding whether to force-sell can see a wrong current value and P&L (the stale tag is on the value only). No bot decision uses these numbers.
recommendation: Show "unknown" instead of a fallback in other units; quote the on-chain balanceOf amount; mark P&L stale together with the price. Fix together with the units decision (card DB-01). Phase 29.
